SESSION.description: Full session deadpool~BASE64 from pair site

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner number with country code no +

BOT_EXPIRY_DAYS.description: Bot active days until expiry. Example 7, 30. Use 0 for unlimited

BOT_EXPIRY_DATE.description: Optional fixed end date YYYY-MM-DD (overrides BOT_EXPIRY_DAYS if set)

BOT_ACTIVATED_AT.description: Optional ISO date when rental started. Leave empty — bot saves first start automatically

BOT_IMAGE.description: Bot/menu image URL (used for .menu loading edits + full menu)

MENU_MEDIA.description: Optional menu image/video URL (overrides BOT_IMAGE if set)

SITE_URL.description: Pair site URL for session buttons

CHANNEL_URL.description: WhatsApp channel link for Join WaChannel button

GROUP_JID.description: Main group JID (stable). Invite links change — bot mints a fresh link from this JID when needed.

GROUP_INVITE.description: Optional. Leave empty if you only use GROUP_JID. Only set if you have a one-time invite code for first join.
